say:3:1710606002:1.text: With respect, Magister Merlin, Prince Orion's orders are clear: only invited guests may enter today.
say:3:1710606002:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，您的尊名我们自是敬仰。但奥利安殿下有令，今日...

say:4:1710606004:1.text: I'm only following orders. I cannot let anyone unauthorized pass.
say:4:1710606004:1.source_cn: 属下只是奉王子殿下之命行事，恕我不能放行。

say:6:1710606005:1.text: Is that the Prince's personal command?

say:7:1710606006:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，我们先借一步说话。

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 我可是大法师梅林，别这么死板

say:9:1710606003:1.text: Your name isn't on today's roster. His Highness specifically said no outsiders today.
say:9:1710606003:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝队长，您的名字不在今天的护卫名册上。殿下特意强...

choice:2:1:2.text: Do you know who this is? Captain Gwyneth.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 我旁边的可是你们的格温妮丝队长
